title: fix(ui): preserve keyboard intent when recovering hovercard focus
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Follow-up to #168790. When a link receives focus before its already-registered hovercard provider mounts, focus recovery used the pointer activation body. The card opened with a hover delay and stayed open after keyboard focus left it because it retained pointer intent.

## User Impact

Recovered keyboard focus now follows the same immediate activation, focus-visible rule, and dismissal path as an ordinary focus event. Pointer hovering keeps its existing delay and behavior.

## Evidence

| Proof | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Existing keyboard-exit regression extended to focus before mounting | Fails before the fix: the card remains after focus moves outside |
| `pnpm test ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-interactions.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` | 41 passed; 3.58 s wrapper wall time |
| `pnpm test ui/src/app/native-link-routing.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` | 16 passed; 3.30 s |
| `pnpm test ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-seeds.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` | 11 passed; 2.69 s |
| Focused lint, formatting, `git diff --check` | Passed |
| Independent Codex review | No actionable P0–P2 findings |

Production LOC is unchanged; tests grow by five lines. This is a behavior-only correction to the viewer migration; its inspected visual pairs remain in #168790. The single Testbox attempt for that lane never admitted a runner and created no lease. Heavy validation uses PR CI.

Exact-head [CI run 38133681023](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38133681023) is green on `9169cc55638c86d4a62d450f19bbacbb241a46ce`, including the required types, lint, ratchets, UI unit and UI E2E checks.
